Title: NETREP ABSENCE: Off to Homelands event

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Following a short nap, I will be leaving on yet another way-too-early flight,
this time to New York City (crunch all the cockroaches you want, we'll make
more), for the Homelands premiere. I wasn't able to get as caught up in
the newsgroups as I wanted before leaving, but the crew is swimming in
laptops, so I shouldn't have any problems dialing in often enough to keep up.
Regular service will resume Sunday night, or sometime Monday. As something
to look forward to, the latest rulings for Magic and VTES should be edited
and released by end of Monday.

Tom Wylie rec.games.trading-cards.* Network Representative for
aa...@cats.ucsc.edu Wizards of the Coast, Inc.
